products.descriptionHtml:
DOOM 2 Commemorative Floppy Disk Antique Silver Edition Official Replica #/5000 — sourced and condition-verified by HOKO Collectables.

📦 Shipping

Australia only. Standard letter post is $3 and untracked. Tracked Parcel is $12.50 and free on orders over $30. Express Post is $19.50. Dispatched within 1–3 business days, Monday to Friday, from Victoria, Australia. Combined postage applies automatically on multiple items.

✨ How We Pack

Singles: double-sleeved, rigid toploader, team bag, rigid cardboard mailer. Foils get foil-safe sleeves. Sealed product is bubble-wrapped and double-boxed.

🎴 Condition Grading

NM · LP · MP · HP · DMG. Assessed in hand, front and back, and scanned individually. We err toward the lower grade.

🤝 About HOKO

Victoria-based, collector-run. 20 years in the hobby. Returns accepted within 7 days of delivery if the item is not as described. Sealed and international orders are final sale. Sealed product is not returnable for change of mind. This doesn't limit your rights under the Australian Consumer Law. Email support@hokocollectables.com or DM @hoko.collectables. Collector first. Seller second.
